rewards.wagerNote: Only bets accepted with the rewards program included.
rewards.playerWager: Your bet volume in the period
rewards.hourlyNote: The share is calculated from the bet volume of wallets above the threshold. Periods are UTC hours; this differs from the rolling last-60-minutes requirement for chat. The absence of an open record does not prove that a payout was made.
rewards.notice: Reward conditions are fixed throughout the phase. There is no guarantee of token value or return; demo games are not part of the rewards program.

rewardsPage.title: Rewards
rewardsPage.lead: Your game rewards and hourly distributions in one place.
rewardsPage.heroText: When the rewards program opens, you can follow your eligibility, the distribution period and the claimable token amount here.
rewardsPage.availText: No verified entitlement is shown yet.
rewardsPage.tokenUndefined: The token is not defined yet
rewardsPage.demoNoToken: Demo games do not earn tokens.
rewardsPage.airdropText: On-chain game activity in the active period will be checked. The distribution amount and the minimum bet requirement will be announced here before the program opens.
rewardsPage.faqQ: Do demo games affect rewards eligibility?
rewardsPage.faqA1: No. Demo credits run on your device. They do not create real bets, a token balance, an airdrop entitlement or staking income.
rewardsPage.faqA2: No calendar, countdown or estimated reward is shown until the hourly program is active.

stakePage.leadLive: Your tokens and your staking position in one place.
stakePage.leadInactive: A space reserved for your tokens and staking position.
stakePage.heroText: Once the stake period, unlock conditions and reward source are published, you will see all of them here before you sign a transaction.
stakePage.status: The staking contract has not been put into service yet.
stakePage.walletNote: A connected wallet does not mean there is an active staking position.
stakePage.noTransfer: No money transfer or token approval is started on this screen.
stakePage.faqQ: What information will be published before staking?
stakePage.faqA: The verified contract address, the supported token, the reward source, fees, the lock period and the unstaking rules. Return rates are not calculated or promised without this information.
